name: keystone-vscode-extension
description: Keystone AI Agent Orchestration Platform - VS Code Extension Foundation

keystone.engine.command.description: Command used to auto-start the local Keystone backend engine when it is not already running (e.g. "uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000"). Never run through a shell -- split on whitespace and executed directly. Left empty (the default), Keystone never guesses a backend location; it reports the engine as unconfigured instead of silently doing nothing.

keystone.engine.cwd.description: Working directory the engine command above is run from (e.g. the Keystone backend checkout's "backend" folder). Required alongside keystone.engine.command for auto-start to activate.

scripts.build: npm run build:webview && npm run build:extension
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run verify:package && vsce package
